detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🩸🩸🩸

You awaken in a body you don't recognize. Disoriented, tattooed and abandoned in a hellish war zone, the distant gunfire is the least of your worries as deranged cultists hunt you down.

 🩸Play alone or with a group. Cooperate or don't.🩸You awaken and are forced to endure Milo's cruel game. You didn’t choose this.🩸Survive endless waves of cultists who are themselves victims of Milo🩸The dead feed your growing mischief of rats and charge your mysterious ability to pop corpses. 🩸Extract with your rats to play games at the arcade to earn more tickets and upgrades.  🩸Earn Traang Bucks by mustering rats and spend them on cosmetics and skins to show your friends how much better you are than them

Features:

  • One hand-crafted map Weltschmerz (more in development)

  • 1-4 player Online Co-op Horde Survival

  • Account and Weapon Progression system

  • Grind-able Weapon Skins

  • World War-era arsenal of 12+ Weapons Including: Kar98, M1 Garand, PPSH-41, M1911

  • Stackable buffs that allow you to build your character to fit your play style

  • Early Access launches with one playable class: Survivor

  • Drink from the Cream Machine and other bizarre interactables to augment your play-through

  • Earn more tickets by playing basketball and spend them in the arcade (Traang) on upgrades

  • Global Leaderboards

  • Custom dismemberment, blood effects, and procedural IK animation system
